scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && npm run test --workspace @xobject/server
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && npm run build --workspace @xobject/web && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts migrate
scripts.admin:create: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts create-admin
